## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows `type(scope): description`
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits
- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] `go build ./...`, `go vet ./...`, `gofmt` and `go mod tidy` pass with no changes
- [ ] Migrations are reversible (up -> down -> up)
- [ ] `docs/openapi.yaml` and README updated if the API changed
- [ ] New routes added to the permission coverage test
